youtube.title: This Swing Ride Is Inside a Nuclear Cooling Tower #Shorts
youtube.description:
West Germany spent around seven billion marks on the fast breeder reactor at Kalkar. It never made a single watt. Today its cooling tower has a swing ride inside.

Full video: "Germany Built a Nuclear Reactor. Now It's a Theme Park." https://youtu.be/f0sKU0_-qCw

Every picture is real. The narration is an AI-generated (synthetic) voice. Sources and full credits are in the full video's description.
Photos: Anefo, Nationaal Archief (CC0); "Wunderland Kalkar, Kettenkarussell Vertical Swing" by TVBuddha, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
Music: Chopin, Nocturne Op. 62 No. 1, Musopen (CC0).

youtube.title: Finished, Kept Hot for Six Years, Never Switched On #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kalkar's fast breeder was finished in 1985. Its liquid sodium was kept hot for six years while the last permits never came. 205 plutonium fuel elements were made for it. None was ever loaded.

Full video: "Germany Built a Nuclear Reactor. Now It's a Theme Park." https://youtu.be/f0sKU0_-qCw

Every picture is real. The narration is an AI-generated (synthetic) voice. Sources and full credits are in the full video's description.

youtube.title: The Farmer Who Fought a Nuclear Reactor #Shorts
youtube.description:
Josef Maas fought the Kalkar fast breeder in court for thirteen years. Then the farm, and the reactor, were both sold.
